footer_line: LIFE KEEPS ARRIVING. GREAT SYSTEMS STAY READY.

title: RAINSTORM
callouts: BOOT TRAY: Contain water and mud right at the door to protect your floors and keep it safe.
UMBRELLA STATION: Store wet umbrellas upright so water drips where it belongs.
WATERPROOF ENTRY MAT: Soak up moisture as soon as you step inside.
WET COAT ZONE: Hang wet jackets with space to dry instead of piling them up.
DRY WALKING PATH: Keep a clear, dry path so wet weather doesn't slow you down.
objective: Respond to wet weather by containing water, mud, and rain gear while keeping the entryway safe, clean, and functional.
game_effect: Successfully contain moisture, organize wet gear, and restore the entryway without creating slippery floors or lasting clutter.
why_it_matters: Rain and moisture can quickly spread through the home, create slip hazards, and damage floors. A prepared entryway contains the mess, protects your home, and keeps routines running smoothly, even on the wettest days.
best_practices: Keep absorbent mats clean and dry.
Empty boot trays and wipe them out.
Dry umbrellas before storing long-term.
Hang wet coats with space for airflow.
Check forecasts so gear is ready before you leave.
Encourage removing wet items at the door, not inside the home.
home_quest_challenge: RAIN READY CHALLENGE. For the next 3 rainy days: Keep all water contained within the entryway. Prevent muddy footprints beyond the entry mat. Restore the space before bedtime.
did_you_know: Containing moisture at the entryway reduces cleaning effort throughout the rest of the home and helps protect flooring from unnecessary wear.

footer_line: RAIN BELONGS AT THE DOOR, NOT THROUGHOUT THE HOUSE.

WINTER GEAR BASKET: Hats, gloves, and scarves have a designated home and are easy to find.

game_effect: Successfully contain snow and slush, organize winter gear, protect flooring, and restore the entryway.
why_it_matters: Snow, ice, and salt can quickly create slippery floors, water damage, and clutter. A prepared entryway keeps winter outside where it belongs and your home safe and welcoming.
best_practices: Empty boot trays and wipe them out.
Brush excess snow off boots outside.
Keep absorbent mats clean and dry.
Hang wet coats with space for airflow.
Store hats, gloves, and scarves together.
Check forecasts so gear is ready before you leave.
Restock missing items after each use.
home_quest_challenge: SNOW READY CHALLENGE. For the next 3 snowy days: Keep all snow and slush contained to the entryway. Return every winter accessory to its home. End each day with a dry, safe, and ready entryway.
did_you_know: Removing snow and road salt at the entryway helps reduce floor wear, minimizes slip hazards, and decreases cleaning throughout the rest of the home.

Review the departure checklist together.
Reset the entryway immediately after returning home.

Avoid blocking the primary entry path.

title: EMPTY YOUR POCKETS
tagline: EVERY ARRIVAL. EVERYTHING HAS A HOME.

WALLET: Return wallet to its home to prevent last-minute searches.
PHONE: Dock or drop your phone in the Launch Pad to keep it ready.

Use a tray, bowl, or landing spot.
Include the whole family in the habit.
Do it every time, no exceptions.
Keep the landing zone clean and inviting.

title: ONE TRIP RULE

callouts: Mail Moving to Office: Take mail to your home office so it doesn't pile up on the Landing Zone.
Water Bottle to Kitchen: Bring drink bottles to the kitchen instead of leaving them by the door.

game_effect: Gain +1 Efficiency whenever you complete a One Trip Rule action.

pro_tip: Keep a small carry basket in the entryway for items headed to other rooms, then empty it as you naturally move through the house.
why_it_matters: Small actions during normal movement prevent clutter from building, save time, and reduce stress. One trip at a time creates a more efficient, organized home for everyone.
best_practices: Never leave the entryway empty-handed.
Carry only items that match your destination.
Finish putting items away before returning.
Encourage every family member to participate.
Make the habit automatic.
home_quest_challenge: ONE TRIP CHALLENGE. For seven consecutive days: Carry at least one misplaced item every time you leave the entryway. Finish each day with an empty Landing Zone.
did_you_know: Small improvements repeated during normal movement eliminate many dedicated cleanup trips.

Make hanging the easiest choice.

Recycle junk right away.
